037public class LuddicPathBaseBarEvent extends BaseBarEventWithPerson {
038        
039        public static enum OptionId {
040                INIT,
041                AGREE,
042                HIRE,
043                HIRE_CONTINUE,
044                REJECT,
045                LEAVE,
046                
047        }
048        
049        public static int COST = 10000;
050        
051        protected LuddicPathBaseIntel intel;
052        
053        public boolean isAlwaysShow() {
054                return true;
055        }
056        
057        public LuddicPathBaseBarEvent(LuddicPathBaseIntel intel) {
058                this.intel = intel;
059        }
060
061        public boolean shouldShowAtMarket(MarketAPI market) {
062                for (LuddicPathCellsIntel cell : LuddicPathCellsIntel.getCellsForBase(intel, true)) {
063                        if (cell.isSleeper()) continue;
064                        if (cell.getSleeperTimeout() > 0) continue;
065                        if (cell.getMarket() == market) return true;
066                }
067                return false;
068        }
069        
070        @Override
071        public boolean shouldRemoveEvent() {
072                return intel.isEnding() || intel.isEnded() || intel.isPlayerVisible();
073        }
074
075        @Override
076        protected void regen(MarketAPI market) {
077                if (this.market == market) return;
078                super.regen(market);
079//              random = new Random(seed + market.getId().hashCode());
080//              person = createPerson();
081        }
082        
083        @Override
084        protected PersonAPI createPerson() {
085                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
086                int level = 1;
087                PersonAPI person = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(faction, level, SkillPickPreference.NO_ENERGY_YES_BALLISTIC_YES_MISSILE_YES_DEFENSE, 
088                                true, null, true, false, 0, random);
089                return person;
090        }
091        
092        @Override
093        public void addPromptAndOption(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
094                super.addPromptAndOption(dialog, memoryMap);
095                
096                regen(dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket());
097                
098                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
099                text.addPara("A " + getManOrWoman() + " with Pather tattoos is staring at you from across the bar " +
100                                "with a desperate gleam in " + getHisOrHer() + " eyes.");
101
102                dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption("Make eye contact with the Pather and walk out into the back alley", this, null);
103        }
104        
105        @Override
106        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
107                super.init(dialog, memoryMap);
108                
109                done = false;
110                dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(person, true);
111                
112                optionSelected(null, OptionId.INIT);
113        }
114        
115        @Override
116        public void optionSelected(String optionText, Object optionData) {
117                if (!(optionData instanceof OptionId)) {
118                        return;
119                }
120                OptionId option = (OptionId) optionData;
121                
122                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
123                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
124                options.clearOptions();
125                
126                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
127                int credits = (int) cargo.getCredits().get();
128                
129                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
130                Color n = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
131                //COST = 10000;
132                
133                switch (option) {
134                case INIT:
135                        text.addPara("After a minute or two of waiting in the alley, the door opens and the Pather " +
136                                        "walks out.");
137                        text.addPara("\"I know who you are\", " + getHeOrShe() + " says. \"I need your help. If they find " +
138                                        "out what I've done... well, let's just say my future with the Path is likely to be a short one. " +
139                                        "So, how about this: you arrange a new identity for me, and I tell you where " +
140                                        "the base supplying the Pather cells at this colony is located.\"");
141                        
142                        boolean canAccept = COST <= credits;
143                        LabelAPI label = text.addPara("You estimate that doing as " + getHeOrShe() + 
144                                                                " asks will run you about %s. You have %s available.",
145                                        h,
146                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(COST),       
147                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(credits));
148                        label.setHighlightColors(canAccept ? h : n, h);
149                        label.setHighlight(Misc.getDGSCredits(COST), Misc.getDGSCredits(credits));
150                        
151                        options.addOption("Agree to " + getHisOrHer() + " terms", OptionId.AGREE);
152                        if (!canAccept) {
153                                options.setEnabled(OptionId.AGREE, false);
154                                options.setTooltip(OptionId.AGREE, "Not enough credits.");
155                        }
156                        addStoryOption();
157                        options.addOption("Suggest that " + getHeOrShe() + " handle " + getHisOrHer() + " own problems", OptionId.REJECT);
158                        break;
159                case AGREE:
160                        text.addPara("You agree to the " + getManOrWoman() + "'s terms and make the necessary arrangements.");
161                        
162                        cargo.getCredits().subtract(COST);
163                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsLossText(COST, dialog.getTextPanel());
164                        
165                        done = true;
166                        intel.makeKnown();
167                        intel.sendUpdate(PirateBaseIntel.DISCOVERED_PARAM, text);
168                        
169                        PortsideBarData.getInstance().removeEvent(this);
170                        options.addOption("Continue", OptionId.LEAVE);
171                        break;
172                case REJECT:
173                        text.addPara("You leave the back alley and return to the bar.");
174                        
175                        options.addOption("Continue", OptionId.LEAVE);
176                        break;
177                case LEAVE:
178                        noContinue = true;
179                        done = true;
180                        break;
181                }
182        }
183        
184        protected void addStoryOption() {
185                String id = "join_id";
186                options.addOption("Offer for " + getHimOrHer() + " to join your fleet instead", id);
187                
188//              final CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
189//              
190//              int num = Misc.getNumNonMercOfficers(playerFleet);
191//              int max = Misc.getMaxOfficers(playerFleet);
192//              
193//              if (num >= max) {
194//                      options.setEnabled(id, false);
195//                      options.setTooltip(id, "Maximum number of officers reached.");
196//              }
197                
198                StoryOptionParams params = new StoryOptionParams(id, 1, "patherJoinFleet", Sounds.STORY_POINT_SPEND_LEADERSHIP,
199                                "Allowed " + person.getNameString() + ", a Luddic Path defector, to join your fleet");
200                
201                SetStoryOption.set(dialog, params, 
202                        new BaseOptionStoryPointActionDelegate(dialog, params) {
203
204                                @Override
205                                public void confirm() {
206                                        super.confirm();
207                                        
208                                        text.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(getHeOrShe()) + " is mistrustful at first, but that turns to surprise and " +
209                                                        "gratitude when " + getHeOrShe() + " realizes you're serious.");
210                                        
211                                        CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
212                                        playerFleet.getFleetData().addOfficer(getPerson());
213                                        getPerson().setPostId(Ranks.POST_OFFICER);
214                                        AddRemoveCommodity.addOfficerGainText(getPerson(), dialog.getTextPanel());
215                                        
216                                        done = true;
217                                        intel.makeKnown();
218                                        intel.sendUpdate(PirateBaseIntel.DISCOVERED_PARAM, text);
219                                        
220                                        PortsideBarData.getInstance().removeEvent(LuddicPathBaseBarEvent.this);
221                                        options.addOption("Continue", OptionId.LEAVE);
222                                        
223                                        OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
224                                        options.clearOptions();
225                                        options.addOption("Continue", OptionId.LEAVE);
226                                }

230                                        //return "Taking on a new officer";
231                                        return "Taking in Luddic Path defector";
232                                        //return null;
233                                }

235                                @Override
236                                public void createDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
237                                        float opad = 10f;
238                                        
239                                        info.addSpacer(-opad);
240                                        
241                                        MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getStats();
242                                        //TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
243                                        TooltipMakerAPI text = info;
244                                        
245                                        //text.setFontSmallInsignia();
246                                        
247                                        Color hl = Misc.getHighlightColor();
248                                        Color red = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
249                                        
250//                                      text.addPara("You consider letting the Pather join your fleet. It's taking a risk, but " +
251//                                                      "something makes you feel that " + getHeOrShe() + " would be " +
252//                                                      "trustworthy if given a second chance.", opad);
253                                        
254                                        text.addPara("You consider letting the Luddic Path defector, " + person.getNameString() + ", join your fleet.", opad);
255                                        
256                                        //text.addPara("----------------------------------------------------------------------------------", opad);
257                                        
258                                        text.addPara("Level: %s", opad, hl, "" + (int) stats.getLevel());
259                                        //text.highlightInLastPara(hl, "" + (int) stats.getLevel());
260                                        
261                                        for (String skillId : Global.getSettings().getSortedSkillIds()) {
262                                                int level = (int) stats.getSkillLevel(skillId);
263                                                if (level > 0) {
264                                                        SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
265                                                        String skillName = spec.getName();
266                                                        if (spec.isAptitudeEffect()) {
267                                                                skillName += " Aptitude";
268                                                        }
269                                                        
270                                                        if (level <= 1) {
271                                                                text.addPara(skillName, opad);
272                                                        } else {
273                                                                text.addPara(skillName + " (Elite)", opad);
274                                                        }
275                                                        //text.highlightInLastPara(hl, "" + level);
276                                                }
277                                        }
278                                        
279                                        String personality = Misc.lcFirst(person.getPersonalityAPI().getDisplayName());
280                                        text.addPara("Personality: %s", opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), personality);
281                                        text.addPara(person.getPersonalityAPI().getDescription(), opad);
282                                        
283                                        //text.addPara("----------------------------------------------------------------------------------", opad);
284                                        
285                                        info.addSpacer(opad * 2f);
286                                        addActionCostSection(info);
287                                }
288                        
289                });
290        }
